description: Makes Microsoft Excel easier with NVDA: announces "blank" after deleting cell content; lists cells with data in the sheet (Control+Shift+D), current row (Control+Shift+R) and current column (Control+Shift+C) with Enter to jump; a sheet manager (Control+Shift+S) to go to, rename, move, protect, hide, insert and delete sheets; announces the table range in the Create Table and Resize Table dialogs; table information, used range and selection summary commands.
